description:
Mapjects is seeking an Oracle web logic developer
 
 Candidate should be capable of migrating existing applications created using Oracle Application Server 10g, oracle PL/SQL cartridge and the Oracle Application express to Oracle Web Logic
 
 The developer must must be able to:
 Experience with Installation, Configuration, Administration and Troubleshooting of servers: Apache, Web logic
 Understanding of LDAP servers such as open LDAP and Windows Active Directory
 Technology skills to recommend tools or troubleshooting skills to evaluate recommend and support new technology as it relates to Web-based applications.
 Oracle Application Express
 
 
 Java
 PL/SQL procedure and packages

 please email word copy of resume to 
 ensure it has your contact information, and phone number to reach you. 
 
 dev@mapjects.com  or jobs@mapjects.com
